patch.value: Enforce a real coverage gate by running tests against TypeScript sources

Baseline measured 2026-07-29 across one source file (index.ts): 83.22 line, 87.45 branch, 87.96 function coverage. Thresholds are pinned at the measured floor (83/87/87) so the number can only move up.

Tests import TypeScript sources rather than dist so coverage reports on editable lines; the gate fails the build when any threshold regresses; the gate fails when a source file never loads, proven by a negative control; thresholds are recorded in package.json as a ratchet at the measured baseline; the gate runs in the release check and in CI on Node 22 and 26
A coverage gate runs in the release check and in CI on both supported Node lines, reports against TypeScript sources, and fails when a source file is untested or a threshold regresses.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Negative control run: adding an untested __probe.ts to the sources list made the gate exit 1 and name the file,so the presence check is not vacuous.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Do not rewrite the node_modules pm-cli dist path when converting test spawn targets; only the package's own dist references become source paths.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Node omits never-loaded files from its coverage report rather than reporting them at zero,so a threshold flag alone is satisfiable by narrowing what the suite imports. Any coverage gate must reconcile the report against the source tree.

patch.value: Tests moved onto TypeScript sources and scripts/coverage-gate.ts wired into release:check and CI.

npm run check passes. npm run coverage passes with 94 tests, the single source file (index.ts) present in the report, at 83.22 line, 87.45 branch and 87.96 function coverage. A negative control adding an untested __probe.ts (added to the sources list for a flat layout) made the gate exit 1 and name that file, so the presence check is not vacuous. Thresholds pinned at 83/87/87. The Node 22 and 26 CI legs are unobserved until the pull request runs.
